marked_text:
Night handover from Amina Kalala at the pump shed in Lubumbashi. Relief stayed [[hours]]6.5[[/]] hours on the suction watch and the posted rate is [[rate]]18.40[[/]] francs, with the wage line left blank for payroll. Callout date is [[issued]]7 March 2026[[/]]. Ticket LB-3370 is still chalked from another pump, so leave that old number alone. STAMP: NIGHT DESK. The carbon tore overti
me across the fold. Vu et noté before the dawn crew takes the keys. I signed under the stair lamp after the breeze dropped and the pump lost prime. No insurer reference was copied onto this slip.

ask.name: insurer
ask.instruction: Insurer reference copied onto the slip

marked_text:
Joseph Ilunga closed the central depot in Mbuji-Mayi with three parts on the bench: [[part]]split casing[[/]], [[part]]bent shaft[[/]], and a [[part]]seized gland[[/]]. He booked [[hours]]4.25[[/]] hours at [[rate]]32.80[[/]] and left the multiplication for payroll. Sheet date [[issued]]2026/08/14[[/]]. A faded quote of 96.15 from an older sheet is still pinned above the hatch. STAMP: HELD. The carbon split replac
ement, so read that as replacement. à suivre once the fitter signs. I wrote the last line under the doorway lamp because the hatch light kept flickering.

Grace Tshibanda handed the yard office in Kananga over with [[item]]gate chain[[/]], [[item]]spare radio[[/]], and [[item]]blue tarp[[/]]. Gross on the chit is [[gross]]540.80[[/]] and the credit slip says [[credit]]73.35[[/]]. The window runs from [[opened]]2026/01/06[[/]] to [[closed]]2026/02/02[[/]]. Someone pencilled 402.10 on the tin from a closed job. STAMP: YARD CLERK. The fold split handov
er. Reste ouvert until the chain is rehung. She wiped mud off the pen before signing, and the yard was soft from the rain.

ask.name: window
ask.instruction: Days from the open date to the close date

marked_text:
Patrick Mukendi checked the berm camp crate in Tshikapa and left [[piece]]clay sample[[/]], [[piece]]torn map[[/]], [[piece]]red flag[[/]], and an [[piece]]empty jerrycan[[/]]. The log date is [[logged]]22 June 2026[[/]]. Docket TS-441 belongs to the previous crew and stays off this count. The live permit code was never written on this page. STAMP: BERM. The pencil split sam
ple on the label. Pour mémoire, he folded the map twice so the damp corner would not smear the date. The berm was quiet after the truck left, just insects and the radio hiss.

ask.name: kit
ask.instruction: Each thing left in the crate

ask.name: logged
ask.instruction: Log date on the crate note

marked_text:
Gate copy from Esther Mwamba at the crusher pad in Kolwezi. The outage opened [[opened]]02/11/2026[[/]] and the pad was signed back [[closed]]21/11/2026[[/]]. Job code on the chit is [[job]]KW-552[[/]]. The board still quotes KW-308 from an older crusher stop. STAMP: GATE. Dust settled on the ink, and a tear split crus
her on the carbon. Vu au portail. She shook the dust off the sheet before clipping it up, and she left the day gap for the clerk to work out from the two dates.

ask.name: closed_on
ask.instruction: Date the pad was signed back

ask.name: gap
ask.instruction: Days from the open date to the sign-back

ask.name: job
ask.instruction: Job code on the gate chit

marked_text:
Stores slip from David Ngoy in the acid warehouse, Likasi. He tagged [[item]]copper bush[[/]], [[item]]oiled rag[[/]], and [[item]]short bolt[[/]]. The three charges are [[charge]]42.15[[/]], [[charge]]18.60[[/]], and [[charge]]7.40[[/]]. Entry date [[posted]]9/12/2026[[/]]. A prior sheet still says 51.40 and should not be copied forward. STAMP: STORES. The stamp edge split ware
house. à classer with the night bundle. He kept the oiled rag off the fresh ink so the tags would stay readable. The aisle smelled sharp and he left the door ajar.

Blotter from the quay office, Chantal Bamba, Matadi. The wharf fee printed on the chit is [[fee]]64.30[[/]] francs. The vessel moved at [[moved]]2026-04-18T16:05[[/]]. The paper date under the stamp is [[paper]]April 3, 2026[[/]]. An old fee of 29.75 is scribbled beside the blotter from a cancelled call. STAMP: QUAY. A tear left blan
k where a lane code might have sat. Copie conforme. She held the blotter down when the wind lifted the corner. No lane code is written on this copy.

ask.name: fee
ask.instruction: Wharf fee printed on the chit

marked_text:
Watch card from Serge Mavungu at the gatehouse in Boma. Night watch ran [[hours]]5.5[[/]] hours at [[rate]]21.20[[/]], and the wage line is still empty. Relief is due at [[due]]7:15 am[[/]]. Card date [[card]]2026-10-22[[/]]. He left [[item]]coil of rope[[/]], [[item]]wet chart[[/]], and [[item]]spare lamp[[/]]. An old extension of 80.05 is pinned above the desk. STAMP: GATEHOUSE. The carbon split wat
ch. Fin de garde. He wrote slowly because mosquitoes kept crowding the bulb. The rope was still damp from the night rain.

Nadine Okemba at the wharf shed in Pointe-Noire. Gross ticket [[gross]]860.40[[/]] less credit [[credit]]125.15[[/]], remainder left off the page. The count starts [[issued]]11/02/2027[[/]] and runs [[credit_days]]18[[/]] days, and she did not ink the landing day. Copy date on the folder is [[copied]]4 May 2027[[/]]. Shelf holds [[item]]hose reel[[/]] and [[item]]paint tin[[/]]. A faded sticker still shows 610.00. STAMP: WHARF. The perforation split cre
dit. Sous réserve. She blotted the salt spots before they reached the lower lines.

ask.name: pay_by
ask.instruction: Start date plus the stated days

marked_text:
Bruno Moukoko, rail shed, Dolisie. Two charges only, [[charge]]88.75[[/]] and [[charge]]36.20[[/]], and he did not add them here. Filed [[filed]]19 August 2026[[/]]. The bin holds [[item]]brake block[[/]], [[item]]oil can[[/]], and [[item]]bent pin[[/]]. A sticker still reads 70.10 from an earlier haul. The live wagon code is not on this note. STAMP: RAIL. A crease split bro
ken across the margin. Bon pour dépôt. He peeled the carbon off his wrist and wrote the bin line again. Heat in the shed made the carbon stick.

Clarisse Moussavou closed the mill cage note in Franceville. The stop began [[opened]]2026-05-04[[/]] and the cage was released [[closed]]2026-05-31[[/]]. The filing date on the sleeve is [[filed]]02/06/2026[[/]]. Job code reads [[job]]FV-88[[/]]. Tag FV-14 hangs on the wrong hook from an earlier stop. STAMP: MILL. The roller split relea
sed on the carbon. Arrêt noté. She waited until the cage door stopped ringing before she signed, and she left the length of the stop for the office.

ask.name: gap
ask.instruction: Days from the stop to the release

ask.name: filed
ask.instruction: Filing date copied on the sleeve

marked_text:
Herve Nguema tallied the timber scale in Oyem. He counted [[item]]resin drum[[/]], [[item]]cloth filter[[/]], [[item]]glass rod[[/]], and [[item]]spare lid[[/]]. Time on the scale was [[hours]]6.5[[/]] hours at [[rate]]18[[/]] francs, and the wage line is blank. Slip date [[slip]]3/10/2027[[/]]. Old tally OY-64 is painted on the beam from last season. STAMP: SCALE. Ink split fil
ter. Compte non fait. He brushed sawdust off the beam so the pencil would not skip. The beam was sticky with resin and the pencil dragged.

ask.name: stock
ask.instruction: Each thing counted on the scale

marked_text:
Solange Minko reopened the customs cage file in Bitam. Fee copied from the docket is [[fee]]250.00[[/]]. This copy is dated [[folder]]3 November 2026[[/]]. The hold clock shows a start of [[issued]]28/06/2026[[/]] and a run of [[hold]]9[[/]] days. A cancelled lot still shows 188.40. STAMP: CAGE. No bond code was left on the slip. The rub split bon
d where that code had been. En attente. She read the docket aloud once because the fan was rattling. The copy is smudged along one edge but the figures are clear.

ask.name: release
ask.instruction: Hold start plus the stated days

marked_text:
Fabrice Ndong packed the pump house bag in Mouila. Inside were [[item]]river gauge[[/]], [[item]]wet logbook[[/]], and [[item]]yellow buoy[[/]]. The reading was taken [[taken]]February 8, 2027[[/]]. Tag MO-12 on the hook is from the dry season and is not the live tag. The live tag was never written on this page. STAMP: PUMP. A fold split gau
ge on the label. Niveau lu. He dried the gauge cord on his sleeve before packing the bag, and the frogs were loud on the bank.

ask.name: bag
ask.instruction: Each thing in the night bag

marked_text:
Irene Bouanga wrote the clinic tent card in Tchibanga. Gross [[gross]]990.00[[/]] minus credit [[credit]]214.35[[/]], and she left the difference off the card. Arrival was logged [[arrived]]21 January 2027 09:40[[/]]. Kit list: [[item]]saline pack[[/]], [[item]]gauze roll[[/]], and [[item]]splint[[/]]. A stale gross of 512.20 sits in the margin from another patient. STAMP: CLINIC. The carbon split arri
val. Soin noté. She steadied the lamp so the arrival line would stay straight. The tent canvas tapped the pole while she wrote.

Yves Moussounda logged the generator hall hire in Koulamoutou. The crew was on the clock for [[hours]]7[[/]] hours at [[rate]]15.25[[/]] francs, and the wage line is blank. The run opened [[opened]]2026-08-03[[/]] and closed [[closed]]2026-08-19[[/]]. Filing date on the sleeve is [[filed]]27/09/2026[[/]]. A rented compressor was quoted at 88.10 on a separate card. STAMP: GEN. Ink split gene
rator under the stamp. Location notée. He signed under the stair lamp because the bench light was out.

ask.name: gap
ask.instruction: Days from the run opening to the close

marked_text:
Pascaline Oyono closed the assay bench in Makokou. Three fees sit on the card, [[charge]]12.40[[/]], [[charge]]33.15[[/]], and [[charge]]8.90[[/]], and she did not add them. The bench closed at [[closed]]16:45[[/]]. Card date [[card]]6 July 2026[[/]]. Left behind: [[item]]core tray[[/]], [[item]]sample bag[[/]], and [[item]]acid bottle[[/]]. A different tray still shows 40.05. STAMP: ASSAY. Smear split bott
le. Fin d'analyse. She closed the tray before a power dip could kill the lamp. The lamp buzzed the whole time she wrote.

Landry Mba wrote the clinic annex slip in Lambarene. Ward name on the slip is [[ward]]east bay[[/]]. The lot code he copied is [[lot]]LB-334[[/]]. Amount due, copied as printed, is [[due]]73.60[[/]]. Date on the sleeve is [[sleeve]]2027-01-29[[/]]. Code DN-44 is stamped on the wrong sleeve and is not this patient. The donor code is absent from this page. STAMP: ANNEX. The punch split slee
ve. Dossier mince. He checked the sleeve twice because the corridor lamp was dim.

ask.name: due
ask.instruction: Amount due copied on the slip
